description: This file 'app.ts' is the main application setup for an Express web server. It includes route definitions, middleware setup, security configurations, in-memory data stores, and documentation integration for a REST API related to device management and authentication.

methods.name: Health endpoint
methods.description: GET /health - Provides liveness and configuration status info.

methods.name: POST /auth/login
methods.description: Issues access and refresh tokens after validating user credentials (stub implementation).

methods.name: POST /auth/refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the access token using a provided refresh token.

methods.name: GET /users/me
methods.description: Returns profile information for the authenticated user.

methods.name: PUT /users/me
methods.description: Updates profile information (e.g., name) for the authenticated user.

methods.name: GET /devices
methods.description: Lists devices accessible within the tenant scope with pagination support.

methods.name: POST /devices
methods.description: Creates a new device within the current tenant.

methods.name: GET /devices/:id
methods.description: Fetches details for a specific device within tenant scope.

methods.name: PUT /devices/:id
methods.description: Updates a device within tenant scope.

methods.name: DELETE /devices/:id
methods.description: Removes a device from the tenant scope.

methods.name: GET /jobs
methods.description: Lists jobs associated with the tenant.

methods.name: GET /jobs/:id
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific job.
